title: Fronius Solar Web AC Power Leaderboard
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fronius:solar power_w=*
| stats sum(power_w) as total_value, avg(power_w) as avg_value by inverter_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks inverter values by total and average ac power across Fronius inverter reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `power_w` values for each Fronius inverter reading event and review total and average ac power by inverter.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total ac power.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews which inverter shows the biggest ac power numbers in your Fronius inverter reading data.
